description: Lists every interactive question type Sparka supports, with its JSON schema, a short guide on when to use it, and a valid example. `sparka_presentation_save` accepts only these types and fields; unknown fields are rejected. Each question needs an `id` chosen by the caller (lowercase slug matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$`, unique in the presentation, kept stable across edits because the deck refers to it), a `type`, and a `prompt`. Scored types (e.g. `quiz`) need correct answers; those answers stay on Sparka's servers and never appear in the deck. `types` limits the result to some types. No account key needed.

types.description: Optional filter, e.g. ["poll","quiz"]. Omit for all.

name: sparka_question_types_list

live_view.description: What the deck receives in counts/revealed for this type.

public_fields.description: Fields returned without the secret key (what a deck may embed).

schema.description: JSON Schema for one question of this type (incl. answer fields).
